title: Jannini's signed, authenticated statement given to the host

tellings.quote: He sent it and I've already left it with you signed.

plain: Ahmed Foratu, a witness speaking on a podcast about a hospital where an alien was said to be operated on, says that a doctor named Jannini sent a signed, authenticated statement. Foratu says he has already handed that signed statement to the host, Jesse Michels, in 2026. It is offered as written backing from a doctor for the story being told.
